purpose: Replace only the unavailable ALIS non-importance-wavelength uncertainty diagnostic from lunar-mystic-computational-precision-v1 with separate monochromatic MYSTIC precision measurements. The v1 result remains immutable and failed; this continuation does not reinterpret it as PASS.

triggerEvidence.failurePattern: All 18 failures are replicate-z checks at 450/650/750 nm. For all 12 ALIS cases mc.rad.std.spc is exactly zero at every non-importance wavelength while 550-nm mcStd is finite/nonzero.
triggerEvidence.interpretation: The parent failure establishes that the frozen ALIS design did not supply the preregistered secondary-wavelength sigma diagnostic on the exact runtime. It is not evidence that 5,000,000 photons are insufficient. Parent thresholds, raw evidence, failure classification, and seeds remain unchanged and consumed.

primaryDocumentation.mcSpectralIsOption: mc_spectral_is [wvl] calculates a spectrum by spectral importance sampling around a calculation wavelength; the manual specifies spectral property treatment but does not promise a usable per-wavelength mc_std estimator away from that calculation wavelength.
primaryDocumentation.basicMysticMcStdEvidence: The exact parent run itself provides finite nonzero mc.rad.std.spc values at its ALIS importance wavelength 550 nm.
primaryDocumentation.continuationChoice: Use ordinary monochromatic MYSTIC at each previously secondary wavelength so each wavelength is itself the calculation wavelength; do not use mc_spectral_is in continuation inputs.

numericalDesign.seedAssignmentOrder: wavelength ascending, observerElevation ascending, relativeAzimuth ascending, replicate ascending
numericalDesign.reasonPhotonBudgetUnchanged: The continuation corrects estimator availability rather than reacting to an observed photon-noise excess; using the same preregistered 5M photons avoids post-result budget tuning.

precisionEvaluation.replicateConsistencyDefinition: abs(L1-L2)/sqrt(sigma1^2+sigma2^2), where L and sigma come from the same monochromatic wavelength and each sigma is the MYSTIC mc.rad.std.spc value from that independent replicate
precisionEvaluation.zeroStdHandling: fail diagnostic support; never replace a zero sigma with epsilon, empirical replicate spread, or a fitted uncertainty
precisionEvaluation.crossMethodAlisComparison: report monochromatic-vs-parent-ALIS radiance differences only as a diagnostic; no post-parent numerical acceptance threshold is introduced
precisionEvaluation.passRule: Every one of the 36 monochromatic replicates must have positive radiance, strictly positive mcStd and relativeMcStd <= 0.10, and every one of the 18 wavelength-by-geometry replicate z checks must be finite and <= 4.0.
precisionEvaluation.failureAction: Do not rerun or increase photons under this identity. Any further continuation requires a new frozen contract and fresh seeds before solver results.

combinedParentContinuationRule.parent550NmRequiredChecks: All six frozen 550-nm replicate pairs passed z<=4 and every 550-nm replicate had relative mcStd <=0.05 in immutable artifact 9727358391.
